title: Quick Irish Lamb Bake
description: A hearty and flavorful lamb bake with turmeric, perfect for a weeknight dinner. This Whole30-friendly dish showcases Irish flair with its peppery and chewy texture.
instructions: Season the lamb shoulder with salt, pepper, and thyme on both sides.
Heat the olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat. Sear the lamb for 2 minutes on each side.
Transfer the lamb to a baking tray and set aside. In the same pot, add the carrots and potatoes. Cook for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Add the onion and garlic to the pot. Cook until the onion is translucent.
Transfer the pot to the preheated oven and bake for 30 minutes.
Add the turmeric to the pot and stir to combine. Return the lamb to the pot, spooning some of the sauce over the lamb.
Return the pot to the oven and continue baking for another 20 minutes, or until the lamb is cooked through and the vegetables are tender.
Let the dish rest for 10 minutes before slicing the lamb and serving with the vegetables.
